bias.en: Rebound · reclaimed the 10-day, under the SAR
bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 10 日均线，仍低于抛物线 SAR

read.en: Arm jumped 12.1% on Nov 11 to $203.36, trading $188.43–207.44. It is above the 5-day ($182.5) and 10-day ($193.8) and below the 30-day ($232.8), 100-day ($265.2) and 200-day ($232.0); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7, below zero, histogram nearly closed (a cross up is close); Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($211.93), and RSI is 44.4.
read.zh: Arm 11月11日大涨 12.1%，收于 $203.36，盘中区间 $188.43–207.44。股价位于 5 日（$182.5）和 10 日均线（$193.8）上方，30 日（$232.8）、100 日（$265.2）和 200 日均线（$232.0）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图接近收拢（临近上穿）；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$211.93），RSI 为 44.4。

read.en: The rally reclaimed $183.2–186.5, $189.9–191.8 and the 10-day with the $196.1 Nov 2 low, now support; the $207.44 high stopped under $208.3–209.5 (Oct 22 low, Nov 4 high). Resistance is $207.4–209.5, then $211.9 (SAR) and $219.4 (Aug 3 low). Support is $193.8–197.1, then $186.5–191.8 and $182.5–183.2. A close above $211.9 would flip the SAR and target $219; below $193.8, $186–192.

r.en: Nov 11 high $207.44; Oct 22 low $208.3; Nov 4 high $209.5

s.en: Nov 4 low $189.88; Nov 9 high $190.09; Nov 4 close $191.80; Nov 11 low $188.43
